summary: Converts a DAT table into a POP point list, using column headers as POP attribute names and one row per POP point. Vector components use column names such as P(0), P(1), and P(2).

key_params.name: attr0columnstype
key_params.note: Select DAT columns by name or number

key_concepts: DAT table rows become POP points
column headers as POP attribute component names
P(0), P(1), P(2), Color(3), and array component headers
question-mark component gathering such as P(?)
point-list conversion without primitive or vertex topology
common_gotchas: The DAT must be structured like POP to DAT output, though the index column is optional for DAT to POP.
Use ? in P(?) to gather P(0), P(1), and P(2) into one float3 P attribute.
Current DAT to POP support converts point lists; primitives and vertices are not yet represented.
